lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are organized into approximately 12 vertical columns, with 5-7 spots per column in the visible mid-lateral region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the spot columns, intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form a lattice of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 14 high-luminance spots are distributed across the first dorsal fin, with a higher density near the leading edge and base, and wider spacing toward the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing (posterior) edge of the first dorsal fin is notably irregular and jagged, characterized by a distinct notch near the upper third of the margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and trailing near the caudal region; a small school of teleosts is present anterior to the pectoral fin.
